note: 12 primary-source verified solid-gold rings retrieved on 2026-10-23 across 6 retailers (including new 22K high-karat house Auvere, closing the 22K purity tier gap, plus weighted 10K, 14K, and 18K bands from Ross-Simons and Automic Gold, and verified Cartier, Blue Nile, and Mejuri listings). Every value is verbatim from the official PDP/feed; ambiguous size-range 'Approximate Fine Weight' values on Auvere PDPs are kept null rather than guessed.
